title: Field Accelerator: Demo Scripts, Scenario Matrix, & Objection Guide for Dedicated GA
creator: Liam O'Rourke
description: Create a compact, high-impact enablement bundle for Sales and Customer Success to accelerate ramp for the Dedicated GA. Bundle includes prioritized demo scripts (6-8 minute and 12-minute variants), a scenario matrix mapping customer archetypes to demo paths, one-page objection handling guide, and a short playbook for live calls and POCs. Focus on clear success criteria, tiered value props (cost predictability, SLA, data isolation), and migration play for existing hosted API customers.
acceptance_criteria: Six demo scripts (two per persona: Developer, Platform, Security) reviewed and approved by PM and Design
Scenario matrix completed and validated with two AE pilots and one CS pilot
One-page objection guide covering top 8 objections with rebuttals and recommended collateral
Assets uploaded to Drive and cross-linked from Sales Confluence page
Feedback loop established with weekly adoption metrics and sample call recordings collected

Record dry-run demos with Solutions Engineering and iterate based on feedback
Coordinate with Docs and Release Notes owners to surface GA messaging in product docs
Publish assets to Sales Confluence and notify GTM via weekly enablement digest
assets_to_create: 12-minute deep-dive demo script (includes troubleshooting and metrics)
